A comma separated list of document types to filter for.

Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.

A comma separated list of team guids to filter for tables owned by users of those teams.

Filter objects by updated_on. May specify __gt, __gte, __lt or __lte.

 API call to: 

 ENDPOINT/updated_on__gt=2021-08-04T15:12:40&updated_on__lt=2021-08-23 

 will result with objects updated_on after  August 4th 2021 at 15:12:40, but before August 23rd 2021. 

. If you want to include lower or upper bound of the range use __gte or __lte respectively.
